steps.do: Check every eligibility requirement. The account is a checking account and OPEN. It has been open at least 3 business days, counted from date_opened to today (get_current_time) and excluding weekends. The account has no ACTIVE card; a card closed in this conversation no longer counts. The balance is at least $25. The customer is 18 or older (date_of_birth). The account has no PENDING card. The address on file is a US domestic address. If any requirement fails, tell the customer what prevents the order, and do not order.
steps.quote: 3) Check eligibility requirements for the specified account

basis.quote: 2) The account must be a checking account (account_type must be 'checking')
3) Account status must be OPEN
4) Account must have been open for at least 3 business days (excluding weekends)
5) Customer cannot have more than 1 active debit cards per checking account
6) Account must have a minimum balance of $25 (to cover potential fees)
7) Customer must be at least 18 years old (verify using date_of_birth)
8) Customer cannot have a pending debit card order for the same account (check debit_cards table for PENDING status)
9) Customer's address on file must be a valid US domestic address (international shipping is not available)

steps.do: Find the account's tier from its product name. ENTRY: Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account. MID: Blue Account, Green Account (checking). PREMIUM: Evergreen Account. ELITE: Bluest Account. If the product is not on this list, do not guess the tier: tell the customer you cannot confirm the replacement fees, and offer a transfer.
steps.quote: MID TIER (Blue Account, Green Account (checking))

basis.quote: ENTRY TIER (Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account)
PREMIUM TIER (Evergreen Account)
ELITE TIER (Bluest Account)

basis.why: No document gives a tier for checking products outside these lists.

steps.do: Count this account's replacement cards in od_cards: issue_reason lost, stolen, fraud or damaged, with a date_issued between 12 months before today (get_current_time) and today. Cards issued for new_account, first_card, expired, upgrade or bank_reissue do not count. Compare the count with the tier limit: ENTRY 2, MID 3, PREMIUM 5, ELITE unlimited. If the limit is already used up: ENTRY may wait or pay a $25 excess_replacement_fee; MID may wait or pay a $15 excess_replacement_fee; PREMIUM must wait (no fee option). Where a fee option exists, ask the customer which they prefer. If they wait, give the date the oldest counted card ages out (its date_issued + 12 months).
steps.quote: 3) Check the date_issued field and count cards issued within the last 12 months

basis.quote: 2) Look for cards with issue_reason of 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud', or 'damaged'
4) Cards with issue_reason of 'new_account', 'first_card', 'expired', 'upgrade', or 'bank_reissue' do NOT count toward the replacement limit.
If customer has exceeded the 2-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out of the 12-month window, OR pay a $25 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 3-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out, OR pay a $15 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 5-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out (no fee option - must wait)
Unlimited replacement cards

steps.do: For an ENTRY-tier account, the wait runs from the card's closure time (note_closure_time) to 48 hours later. Until that time has passed, a replacement cannot be ordered, even if an excess fee is paid. Tell the customer the earliest time they can order: the closure time + 48 hours, or the later date if they are also waiting for the limit. Do not order now. MID, PREMIUM and ELITE accounts have no waiting period.
steps.if: the account is ENTRY tier and its card was closed less than 48 hours ago
steps.quote: 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered

basis.quote: 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered
No waiting period - can order immediately after closure

steps.do: Offer only the shipping options the tier allows, each with its delivery_fee. ENTRY: STANDARD only, $0 (no expedited option). MID: STANDARD $0 or EXPEDITED $15. PREMIUM: STANDARD or EXPEDITED $0, RUSH $35. ELITE: STANDARD, EXPEDITED or RUSH, all $0; the card ships the same business day if ordered before 2pm EST. Delivery times: STANDARD 7-10 business days, EXPEDITED 3-5, RUSH 1-2. If the customer asks for an option the tier does not offer, tell them it is not available for this account.
steps.if: od_eligibility, od_history and od_entry_wait allow ordering now
